title: Read access and error logs
summary: An access log records requests. An error log records problems such as missing permissions or invalid configuration.
introduction: An access log records requests. An error log records problems such as missing permissions or invalid configuration. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain read access and error logs
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An access log records requests. An error log records problems such as missing permissions or invalid configuration.
Use writable log paths in a private practice setup. The two logs answer different questions.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Choose which log helps find a file-permission error.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Avoid exposing logs publicly or recording unnecessary sensitive data.
For more detail later, use this [Nginx further reading](https://nginx.org/en/docs/beginners_guide.html).
